title: Simultaneous local lifts of finitely many sections
statement: Let C be a category with a Grothendieck topology J (maximal sieves cover, and covering sieves satisfy pullback stability and transitivity), D a concrete category, F,G:C^op→D presheaves, and q:F→G locally surjective [def-cbc-generalized-cover]: for each section s over U, the sieve of arrows f:V→U admitting a preimage of G(f)(s) under q_V covers U. For any finite index type I and sections s_i of G over U, there is a covering sieve S on U such that for every f:V→U in S there are a_i in F(V), simultaneously for all i, with q_V(a_i)=G(f)(s_i). The category and value universes are independent. The empty finite type is allowed.

proof.text: For a finite subset b of the index set, inductively intersect the image sieves of its sections. The empty subset uses the maximal covering sieve; adding an index uses Mathlib Presheaf.imageSieve_mem and GrothendieckTopology.intersection_covering. Membership in the intersection gives a preimage for every index in b. Apply this to the finite universal set and choose the individual preimages.

lean.statement:
theorem finite_local_section_lifts
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    {D : Type w} [Category.{z} D] {FD : D → D → Type*} {CD : D → Type t}
    [∀ X Y, FunLike (FD X Y) (CD X) (CD Y)] [ConcreteCategory D FD]
    {F G : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ D} (q : F ⟶ G) [IsLocallySurjective J q]
    {U : C} {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (s : ι → ToType (G.obj (op U))) :
    ∃ S : Sieve U, S ∈ J U ∧
      ∀ (V : C) (f : V ⟶ U), S f →
        ∃ a : ι → ToType (F.obj (op V)), ∀ i, q.app (op V) (a i) = G.map f.op (s i)
